remarks: Welcome to Clocktower Close a historic Norwalk landmark renovated to perfection to provide incredible living space and unique amenities throughout, including two outdoor courtyards, full gym with locker room and sauna, business/meeting room, community kitchen, game rooms, billiard room and coin-op laundry. ALL OF THESE AMENITIES ARE INCLUDED IN RENT! Enter into this light, bright and airy spacious (840 sq. ft.) condo featuring modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, huge breakfast counter, open concept living room dining area combo with walk-in closet right off the entrance. Fabulous chic fully renovated oversized bath, generous sized bedroom with walk-in closet. This lovely condo is centrally located within easy walking distance to shops, restaurants and bus line. Only minutes away from highways, both East and South Norwalk train stations, bustling downtown South Norwalk shops, gourmet eateries, SoNo mall, parks and beaches. A wonderful lifestyle awaits you! AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS FOR APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS.
